108 archived items and 72 true same-story pairs (EVALS §4). Every variant
sits on a different feed from its base. same_url variants keep the base's
canonical URL (with fresh tracking noise) - exactly 10 same-story pairs share
a canonical URL, which is the naive URL-only clusterer's entire recall.
Everything else about a variant (which alternate headline, which surface-free
